Politics · India

Trump cites Indian elections in US voter ID push

U.S. President Donald Trump referenced India's general elections, stating that over 646 million people participated and less than 1% used postal ballots. He cited this to support his "SAVE America Act," which advocates for voter identification. The coverage from various outlets focused on Trump's use of India's electoral system as an example for U.S. voting reforms.
